title: Pre-trade checklist

claims.text: Worked example FR-20261022-B-202703-P: an unproven budget of 0.250R ($62,500) over a shock loss of $669.57 per lot set 93 lots of Put Vertical Spread +P80; -P65. Worst priced day $62,270. The most it can lose is the full $161,820 paid.
